definitions.ask: Should `\` `\` type one literal `\`, so a draft can still start with an escape like `\#fix`?
definitions.why: Leading `\` escapes such as `\#fix`, `\# Heading`, `\%c` would otherwise be untypable

choices.label: A second `\` right away turns the `/` into a literal `\` (one-shot arm, like the Ctrl-G leader)
No escape gesture; a leading literal `\` needs a paste or a caret move
